title: Above mantelpiece
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：above　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 above 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the painter kept the brush ① above the snow line at the easel, and everybody in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: the brush had been left ② above the mantelpiece, and nobody had asked a single question. The painter had come to the studio two seasons earlier and spoke little of the studio he had left behind him.

The catalogue for May 1949 puts it plainer. It was done ③ above all suspicion, and the visitor who kept the brush had kept it ④ above the rest of the village twice before the winter came; nothing in the studio was ever done above all suspicion in those days. The visitor wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ above the noise upstairs, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ above the usual price; he was not a man who explained himself, and the studio had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1962 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was that the brush be kept ⑦ above a rope and a pulley, and that the names be written ⑧ above a single sheet of paper. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried above a rope and a pulley.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1965 she kept the brush ⑨ above the snow line again when nobody else would, and ⑩ above the mantelpiece, she said in 1967, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the brush in the same easel for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the studio never forgot what had been done above the mantelpiece.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…上方（表时间：above the snow line）
B. prep. 在…上方（表处所：above the mantelpiece）
C. prep. 高于（表方式／状态：above all suspicion）
D. prep. 高于（引出施动者或相关的人：be kept above the rest of the village）
E. prep. 在…上方（表原因：above the noise upstairs）
F. prep. 高于（表对象／目的：above the usual price）
G. prep. 在…上方（表工具／材料：above a rope and a pulley）
H. prep. 高于（表载体／处所：written above a single sheet of paper）

items.q: above the rest of the village
above a rope and a pulley
above a single sheet of paper

answers.why: above 意为“在…上方”，此处引出时间 the snow line（雪线），说明那件小小的画笔是在何时留下的。
above 意为“在…上方”，此处引出处所 the mantelpiece（壁炉台），说明东西被放在何处。
above 意为“高于”，此处引出方式或状态 all suspicion（一切嫌疑），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
above 意为“高于”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 村里其余的人：be kept above the rest of the village。
above 意为“在…上方”，此处引出原因 the noise upstairs（楼上的响动），说明整件事由何而起。
above 意为“高于”，此处引出对象或目的 the usual price（平常的价钱）。
above 意为“在…上方”，此处引出工具或材料 a rope and a pulley（一副绳索滑轮）。
above 意为“高于”，此处引出载体 a single sheet of paper（一张纸）：names written above a single sheet of paper。
above 意为“在…上方”，1965 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的画笔，此处仍引出时间 the snow line。
above 意为“在…上方”，母亲 1967 年那句话引出的仍是那一处壁炉台。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年雪线前后，画师把那件小小的画笔留在了画架。（above the snow line）
那件小小的画笔被放在壁炉台，谁也没有过问。（above the mantelpiece）
整件事是一切嫌疑做成的，展品目录上写得明白。（above all suspicion）
入冬之前，那件小小的画笔已经由村里其余的人留着过两回。（be kept above the rest of the village）
叔叔说，整件事是由楼上的响动起的。（above the noise upstairs）
他说，家里从来没有人为平常的价钱做过这件事。（above the usual price）
answers: In 1955 the painter kept the brush above the snow line at the easel.
The brush had been left above the mantelpiece, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done above all suspicion, or so the catalogue says.
The brush had been kept above the rest of the village twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun above the noise upstairs.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it above the usual price.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 above 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the painter kept the brush above the snow line, and nobody forgot it.
The brush had been left above the mantelpiece for three seasons.
The work was done above all suspicion, as it always was in those days.
The brush had been kept above the rest of the village twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the brush above the snow line again when nobody else would.
The whole studio never forgot what had been done above the mantelpiece.
